sentences.text: Between 03:00 and 05:20, the bathroom began to record an odd phenomenon: the air drying out.
The humidity dropped sharply, falling significantly below the expected range of 49.3 % to 50.0 %.
At the end of the period, the bathroom’s humidity registered a mysterious 41.9 %.
This sudden dip was markedly lower than the prediction of 49.6 %.
